key_facts: Spontaneous onset with no previous trauma
No improvement with topical antifungal cream
Negative for HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C
Ki-67 index showed low proliferation in endothelial cells
Poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation
Prominent hemosiderin deposits on Perls Prussian blue staining

raw.rationale: The presence of poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation, small dilated vascular channels, and prominent hemosiderin deposits, along with a low Ki-67 index, are characteristic features of hobnail hemangioma.

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Negative for HHV-8 and lack of systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Cavernous hemangioma
rejected.why: Lack of large, dilated vascular spaces
